subject: Mona Lisa painting
title: What If Someone Stole the Mona Lisa? In 1911 a Handyman Did

scenes.text: What if someone stole the Mona Lisa? In 1911, a man simply carried it out.
August 21st, a Monday. The Louvre is closed. A former museum handyman in a white smock lifts the painting off the wall.
He had helped build its glass case. In a stairwell he strips the frame and walks out.
For more than a day, nobody notices. When the Louvre reopens a week later, thousands come to stare at the empty wall.
Police question Pablo Picasso. The painting spends two years in a trunk in a Paris apartment.
In December 1913 the thief offers it to a dealer in Florence, and is arrested. The theft only made the painting more famous.

description:
What if the Mona Lisa vanished from the Louvre? On 21 August 1911, Vincenzo Peruggia, an Italian workman who had helped build the painting's glass case, took it off the wall and walked out.
The loss went unnoticed for more than a day, the museum closed for a week, and thousands came to see the bare wall. Poet Guillaume Apollinaire and Pablo Picasso were questioned and cleared. Peruggia kept the painting in a trunk for two years, was arrested in Florence in December 1913, and served about seven months.
